# Aardvark Book Club — animation system, reverse-engineered

Studied 2026-10-04 for GovOS's frontend motion work. Read from the live site's own files, fetched read-only:
`https://www.aardvarkbookclub.com/` (HTML), its custom script `https://slater.app/18601/54937.js` (5,540 lines,
**unminified** — the comment on line 1 says it was generated by Slater.app, a code host for Webflow sites), its custom
stylesheet `https://slater.app/18601/54934.css` (2,312 lines) and the Webflow stylesheet. Line numbers below refer to
`54937.js` as fetched that day. The five screen recordings supplied with the brief were read frame by frame.

Every finding is tagged **[SOURCE]** (read in the code), **[OBSERVED]** (seen in the recordings, not traced to code) or
**[INFERRED]** (a conclusion from both). Nothing here is the site's content, and none of it is copied into GovOS.

---

## B. Animation Architecture

- **One file, data-attribute driven.** Every effect is a function `initX()` that looks for `[data-x]` inside the
  current page container (`nextPage`) and does nothing if it is absent: `const has = (s) => !!nextPage.querySelector(s)`
  (line 21) and calls such as `if (has("[data-accordion]")) initAccordion();` **[SOURCE]**
- **Three lifecycle buckets** (lines 519–610) **[SOURCE]**:
  - `initOnceFunctions()` — first load only: Lenis, a 60 ms-debounced resize registry, `--vw`, and the shared RAF loop
    `initAnimate()`.
  - `initBeforeEnterFunctions(next)` — before the page's enter animation: background SVG animation, hero image
    sequence, the two button-hover systems, filter slider.
  - `initAfterEnterFunctions(next)` — after it: everything scroll- or hover-driven (call-outs, handwritten text,
    footer parallax, sliders, accordion, FAQ sidebar, badges, benefits, momentum hover, gift, tagline curve, genre
    interaction, box sequence, plop-in, tabs, scrolling CTA, search…), then `initMenu()`,
    `initDetectScrollingDirection()`, `lenis.resize()`, `ScrollTrigger.refresh()`.
- **Global defaults** (lines 25–31) **[SOURCE]**: `staggerDefault = 0.05`, `durationDefault = 0.6`,
  `CustomEase.create("osmo", "0.625, 0.05, 0, 1")`, `CustomEase.create("path-ease", "0.78, 0.18, 0.18, 1")`,
  `CustomEase.create("energy", "M0,0 C0.32,0.72 0,1 1,1")`, `gsap.defaults({ ease: "osmo", duration: 0.6 })`.
- **Reduced motion** is tracked live (`rmMQ`, lines 15–18) and most effects are wrapped in
  `gsap.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)")` or `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` **[SOURCE]**.
- **One RAF loop for sliders**: `const rafs = []` and `initAnimate()` calls each registered function every frame
  (lines 4658, 4910–4913) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Page container lifecycle** is Barba's; ScrollTriggers whose trigger lives in the old container are killed in
  `afterLeave` (lines 2128–2139) **[SOURCE]**.

## C. Page Load Timeline

`barba.init` → first visit runs `once()` → `initOnceFunctions()` then `runPageOnceAnimation(next)` (lines 2187–2196)
**[SOURCE]**. That timeline (lines 616–1333), for the home page:

```
Timeline "once" (gsap.timeline(); positions relative to label "start" = 0)
 set: header yPercent -100; transition SVG path drawSVG "0% 100%"; transition logo scale 0 rotate -64 hidden
 set: hero words  yPercent -10, xPercent 40, scaleY .1, scaleX .85, rotate 8, opacity 0, origin top left
 set: paragraph + CTA  opacity 0, y -0.75em
 set: hero visual (book)  opacity 0, y 5em, rotate -43
 set: handwritten chars  opacity 0, rotate 22, x -0.25em, y 0.5em
 set: hero sequence  opacity 0, scale 1.15, rotate 6
 set (≥992px): hero bg  clipPath ellipse(20% 0% at 100% 100%)

 start+0.05 → logo in: scale 1, rotate 0, autoAlpha 1, 0.65s, elastic.out(1,0.72)
 start+0.50 → logo out: scale 0, rotate 64, autoAlpha 0, 0.60s, elastic.in(1,0.72)
 start+0.65 → transition SVG stroke wipe: keyframes {95%: strokeWidth 8%, circ.out; 100%: drawSVG "100% 100%"}, 1.25s
 start+1.60 → header yPercent 0, 0.5s, "energy"                        (position start+1.1, delay .5)
 start+1.30 → hero bg clip ellipse(150% 130% at 100% 100%), 1.1s, circ.out   (≥992px; delay .2)
 start+1.35 → hero words keyframes {10%: opacity 1; 100%: identity, elastic.out(1,0.72)}, 0.875s each, stagger 0.088
 start+1.55 → paragraph opacity 1 y 0, 0.35s, "energy"
 start+1.55 → handwritten chars to identity, 0.75s, elastic.out(1,0.75), stagger 0.016
 start+1.55 → easter egg opacity 1, 0.35s, "energy"
 start+1.60 → hero sequence opacity 1 scale 1 rotate 0, 0.85s, expo.out
 start+1.60 → hero visual opacity 1 y 0 rotate -21, 0.75s, elastic.out(1,0.72)
 start+1.625→ CTA opacity 1 y 0, 0.35s, "energy"
 at 2.00s   → tl.call(resetPage + scrollToInitialHash)   (absolute position 2)
```
All values **[SOURCE]** (lines 675–1064, 1327–1330). The FAQ, book and gift pages run the same pattern with their own
elements (lines 763–936). Recording 1 shows exactly this order **[OBSERVED]**: purple field + logo pop, the yellow
ribbon sweeping across, words landing one by one with a rotation, the book swinging in.

## D. Hero Animation

- **Title** — `new SplitText(title, { type: "words", tag: "span", wordsClass: "split-word" })` (line 702). Each word
  starts squashed and offset (`scaleY .1, scaleX .85, xPercent 40, yPercent -10, rotate 8`, origin top left) and
  springs to identity with `elastic.out(1,0.72)`, 0.875 s, stagger 0.088 s; opacity snaps to 1 at the first 10 %
  of each word's tween **[SOURCE]**.
- **Handwritten line** — split into words + chars; chars from `rotate 22, x -0.25em, y 0.5em, opacity 0` to
  identity, 0.75 s, `elastic.out(1, 0.75)`, stagger 0.016 **[SOURCE]**.
- **Background** — on ≥992 px a `clip-path: ellipse()` grows from the bottom-right corner, 1.1 s `circ.out`
  **[SOURCE]**.
- **Visual** — the book drops from `y 5em, rotate -43` to `rotate -21` with an elastic overshoot **[SOURCE]**.
- **Hero image sequence** — `<canvas data-frames="120" data-fps="24" data-digits="3">` with WebP frames from a CDN;
  frames are loaded through a queue, drawn "cover"-fitted at device pixel ratio, and played by
  `gsap.to(playhead, { frame: frames, duration: frames / fps, ease: 'none', repeat: -1, paused: true })`.
  A ScrollTrigger (`start 'top bottom'`, `end 'bottom top'`) plays it on enter/enterBack and pauses on leave
  (lines 3572–3934). Desktop ≥992 px only **[SOURCE]**.
- **Mouse interaction in the hero** — none found in the hero code **[SOURCE: absence]**.

## E. Navigation/Menu

- **Header entrance** — `yPercent -100 → 0`, 0.5 s, `energy`, at `start+1.1` (+0.5 delay) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Menu** (`initMenu`, lines 4915–4955) — class toggles only: `is--active` on `[data-menu]`, `has--menu-open` on
  `<html>`, `lenis.stop()` while open, Esc closes. The open/close motion itself is CSS **[SOURCE]**.
- **Scroll state** — `initDetectScrollingDirection` sets `data-scrolling-started="true|false"` once Lenis passes
  50 px (lines 4957–4968); despite the name it records "has scrolled", not direction **[SOURCE]**.
- **Active nav item** — the current page's button runs `ear-twitch-left/right` keyframes (5.2 s, 0.6 s delay,
  infinite): two mask-image "ears" on the button background twitch a few degrees **[SOURCE]**; this is the
  "Ear-popping button hover" element on Awwwards **[INFERRED]**.
- **Theme per page** — `applyThemeFrom(container)` copies `data-page-theme` to the body and flips the nav and the
  transition colour (lines 2236–2261) **[SOURCE]**.

## F. Text Animation System

GSAP SplitText, always `tag: "span"`, classes `split-word` / `split-char` **[SOURCE]**. 17 instantiations:

| Where | Split | Trigger | Motion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hero / FAQ / book / gift titles (once + enter) | words | page load / transition | squash-stretch spring, 0.875 s, stagger 0.088 |
| Handwritten texts (hero, gift) | words, chars | page load | rotate 22 → 0, elastic, stagger 0.016 |
| `[data-handwritten-text-inview]` | words, chars | ScrollTrigger `top 95%` | same as above, 0.75 s |
| Box-sequence texts | words, chars | scroll progress thresholds | elastic 0.625 s |
| `[data-button]`, `[data-button-alt]` labels | chars | hover / `:focus-visible` | jiggle (section J) |

No line splitting, no masks and no clip-path on text anywhere in the script **[SOURCE: absence]**.

## G. Image Animation System

- **Canvas image sequences** for the hero visual (time-based loop) and the 3D box (scroll-scrubbed) — section H.
- **Clip-path ellipse** reveal of hero backgrounds **[SOURCE]**.
- **Book slider tilt** — each card gets a random alternating tilt (`gsap.utils.random(1.5, 3, 0.1)` deg and
  `random(3, 9, 0.1)` % y-offset, sign by index parity); every frame `onUpdate` sets
  `translateY(strength·yOffset%) rotate(strength·rotation deg)` with `strength = sin(clamp(norm,-2,2)·1.2)` from the
  card's distance to the slider centre (lines 33–167) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Hover lift** on a book card — CSS: `.books-slider__item:has(.books-slider__item-link:hover)
  .books-slider__item-bg-bottom { translate: 0 1.5em 0; transition: translate .35s .1s var(--ease-bounce) }` and
  the CTA label fades in **[SOURCE]**. Recording 2 shows the hovered cover rising above its neighbours **[OBSERVED]**.
- **Pop-ins** — `fromTo` from `scale 0` + random rotation (±33°) to identity with `elastic.out(1,0.75)`
  (benefits, gift, plop-in) **[SOURCE]**.

## H. ScrollTrigger System

No pinning; every trigger is either `once`, `toggleActions`, a play/pause switch, or `scrub` **[SOURCE]**.

- **Box sequence** (`[data-box-sequence]`, HTML `data-scroll-start="top 85%"`, `data-scroll-end="bottom 80%"`):
  `ScrollTrigger.create({ scrub: true, onUpdate })` maps progress to one of 120 canvas frames; text timeline plays at
  progress ≥ 0.3 (`timeScale 1.5`), reverses at ≥ 0.6 (`timeScale 3.5`); final text plays at ≥ 0.81
  (`timeScale 1.25`). A second scrubbed tween moves the canvas `yPercent -25 → 0` over the first 25 % (≥992 px;
  -50 below; 0 for the short variant) (lines 3102–3566) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Footer parallax** (≥991 px): `start "clamp(top bottom)"`, `end "clamp(top top)"`, `scrub 0.2`; top and bottom
  layers `y -12.5em → 0`, visual `scale .9, xPercent -35, y 17.5em, rotate 30 → identity`, overlay opacity
  `.55 → 0`, all `ease "none"`, chained with `"<"` (lines 5370–5432) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Tagline curve**: SVG `textPath` `startOffset` scrubbed, `start '-40% bottom'`, `end '60% top'`, `scrub 0.5`
  **[SOURCE]**.
- **Scrolling CTA**: `y: "12em"`, 0.8 s, `energy`, `toggleActions "play none none reverse"`, `start "top 80%"`,
  `end "bottom bottom"` **[SOURCE]**.
- **One-shot entrances**: call-out cards `top 85%` (yPercent `+=150`, 1.05 s elastic, stagger 0.088); benefits
  `top 25%` (0.85 s, stagger 0.072); gift `top 72%`; badge and plop-in `top 80%` (paused timeline played on enter)
  **[SOURCE]**.
- **Background SVG strokes**: a repeating 3 s + 3 s `sine.inOut` stroke-width/rotate yoyo, played only while the
  element is on screen (`top bottom` → `bottom top`) **[SOURCE]**.
- **FAQ sidebar**: one ScrollTrigger per section, `start/end "top|bottom 136px"`, toggles the active link; links
  scroll with `lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -96, duration: 1.1, lock: true })` **[SOURCE]**.

## I. Smooth Scrolling

```js
lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: 0.2, autoRaf: true, anchors: true });   // lerp 0.18 and wheelMultiplier 1.25 commented out
lenis.on("scroll", ScrollTrigger.update);                         // gsap.ticker driving lenis.raf is commented out
```
(lines 2263–2284) **[SOURCE]**. Lenis runs its own RAF (`autoRaf`), and ScrollTrigger is told to update on every
Lenis scroll. Scroll is stopped while a page transition runs (`beforeEnter`) and while the menu is open, then
resumed with `lenis.resize(); lenis.start()` **[SOURCE]**. `history.scrollRestoration = "manual"` and
`ScrollTrigger.clearScrollMemory("manual")` (lines 7–8) **[SOURCE]**.

## J. Hover/Mouse Interactions

- **Button squash-and-recover (CSS)** — on `:hover, :focus-visible` the background gets `scale: 0.955 0.925`
  (0.15 s, soft-overshoot) while `transform: scale(1.0471, 1.0811)` — the exact inverse — runs 0.35 s after a 0.15 s
  delay on `--ease-bounce`, so the surface dips and springs back past 1 **[SOURCE]**. The label wrap tilts
  (`rotate 4deg` against `-4deg`) and the icon swings (`-18deg` against `18deg`) with the same two-phase timing.
  `:active` uses `--button-click-scale` **[SOURCE]**.
- **Button letter jiggle (GSAP)** — `initButton/initButtonAlt`: label split into chars; on hover a paused timeline
  restarts: keyframes `20%: yPercent 55, scaleY .3, rotate 17 (power2.in)` → `100%: identity
  (elastic.out(1,0.4))`, 0.725 s, `stagger.amount 0.225`; on leave it pauses and eases back in 0.2 s; also fires on
  `:focus-visible` (lines 5164–5368) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Momentum hover** — `initMomentumBasedHover` (fine pointers only): pointer velocity sampled per RAF; on
  `mouseenter` the target gets `gsap.to(target, { inertia: { x/y velocity = clamp(vel·25, ±1080), rotation velocity
  = clamp(torque·15, ±60), end 0, resistance 160 } })` — the card is flicked in the direction of the cursor and
  settles back (lines 4314–4385) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Call-out cards** — the container is divided into N horizontal portions; the card under the cursor straightens
  and scales 1.075 while siblings slide `xPercent 45/(index - i)`, all `elastic.out(1,0.75)` 0.85 s; on leave they
  return to a random tilt (lines 5017–5119) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Genre discovery** — CSS does the motion, JS sets variables: hovering a list item swaps the display face for a
  handwritten face (`opacity`, `scale .75 1.25 → 1`, `blur(.0625em) → 0`, 0.3 s `--ease-bounce`), neighbours shift
  ±2em / ±0.75em via `:has()`; a highlight frame `.genre__scope` translates to the hovered row
  (`--active-index`, `--translate-speed: 0.2s`); four floating covers scale in (0.4 s bounce) to random offsets
  `--x/--y/--r` (±15) plus a pointer parallax `--px/--py` with `0.85s var(--ease-elastic-out)` (lines 3935–4053 and
  the `.genre__*` CSS) **[SOURCE]**. Recording 3 matches **[OBSERVED]**.
- **Accordion** — `<details>` height animated with WAAPI, 450 ms, `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`, interruptible
  (lines 4570–4655) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Pop-up** — opens on pointerenter, locks open on click (lines 5434–5457) **[SOURCE]**.
- **Custom cursor / magnetic buttons** — none found **[SOURCE: absence]**.

## K. Page Transitions

Barba, `sync: true`, `preventRunning: true`, `timeout: 7000`, prefetch (`timeout 2500, limit 0`) **[SOURCE]**.

```
leave(current, next)     (runPageLeaveAnimation, lines 1335–1389)
  next hidden; overlay path strokeWidth 8%, drawSVG "0% 0%"
  0.00 → path keyframes {15%: strokeWidth 8%; 90%: drawSVG "0% 100%"; 100%: strokeWidth 70%}, 1.25s (osmo)
  0.50 → logo scale 1 rotate 0 autoAlpha 1, 0.65s, elastic.out(1,0.72)
  onComplete → current.remove()
beforeEnter → new container fixed at top; lenis.stop(); before-enter inits; theme applied
enter(next)              (runPageEnterAnimation, lines 1391–2105)
  label startEnter at 1.25s → next visible, header hidden, path drawSVG "0% 100%"
  startEnter      → path keyframes {95%: strokeWidth 8% circ.out; 100%: drawSVG "100% 100%"}, 1.25s
  startEnter      → logo out: scale 0 rotate 64, 0.45s, elastic.in(1,0.72)
  startEnter+0.4  → header + hero choreography (same values as section C)
  pageReady       → resetPage (scrollTo 0, clear fixed position, lenis.resize/start); promise resolves
afterEnter → after-enter inits, lenis.start(), ScrollTrigger.refresh()
afterLeave → kill ScrollTriggers of the old container, destroy the box sequence
```
Reduced motion: leave sets the old container invisible at once and enter resolves immediately **[SOURCE]**.
Two identical transition definitions exist, named `self` and `default` **[SOURCE]**.

## L. Reusable Animation Functions

`init*` per `[data-*]` hook (B), `destroyBoxSequence` / `destroyHeroSequence` registries, `killChildTweensOf`,
`debounceOnWidthChange`, `setViewportSizes`, `applyThemeFrom`, `resetPage`, `scrollToInitialHash`,
`initBarbaNavUpdate`, and the slider class family `ParallaxSlider / CenterSlider / Slider / FilterSlider extends
Smooothy` registered into the shared `rafs` loop **[SOURCE]**. There is no general `reveal()` or `splitText()`
helper: each effect calls `new SplitText` and builds its own timeline **[SOURCE]**.

Only the site's own call-sites (abbreviated), not library code:

```js

CustomEase.create("energy", "M0,0 C0.32,0.72 0,1 1,1");
gsap.defaults({ ease: "osmo", duration: 0.6 });

// hero words (lines 987–1012)

  "10%": { opacity: 1 }, "100%": { yPercent: 0, xPercent: 0, scaleY: 1, scaleX: 1, rotate: 0, ease: "elastic.out(1,0.72)" } },
  duration: 0.875, stagger: 0.088, delay: 0.25 }, "start+=1.1");

// button jiggle (lines 5194–5218)
tl.to(chars, { keyframes: { "20%": { yPercent: 55, scaleY: 0.3, rotate: 17, ease: "power2.in" },
  "100%": { yPercent: 0, scaleY: 1, rotate: 0, ease: "elastic.out(1,0.4)" } }, duration: 0.725, stagger: { amount: 0.225 } });

// momentum hover (lines 4374–4381)
gsap.to(target, { inertia: { x: { velocity: vx, end: 0 }, y: { velocity: vy, end: 0 },
  rotation: { velocity: vr, end: 0 }, resistance: 160 } });

gsap.timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: "clamp(top bottom)", end: "clamp(top top)", scrub: 0.2 } })
```

```css
/* easing tokens (54934.css lines 18–23) */
--ease-smooth: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);   --ease-soft-overshoot: cubic-bezier(0.59, 1, 0.88, 1.01);
--ease-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.57, 0.64, 1); --ease-soft-bounce: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.17, 0.64, 1);
```

The site also sizes everything in `em` from one fluid root: `--size-font: calc(clamp(992px, 100vw, 3840px) / (1920 / 16))`
(1 em = 16 px at a 1920 px viewport), with breakpoint overrides at 991 / 767 / 479 px **[SOURCE]**.

## O. Reproduction Blueprint

What makes it feel the way it does, in order of effect:

1. **One easing family, used everywhere.** A slow-in/fast-out "osmo" curve for movement, a sharp "energy"
   ease-out for small UI, `elastic.out(1, ~0.72)` for anything that *lands*, and a bounce bezier
   (`0.34, 1.57, 0.64, 1`) for hover recoveries. Defining these once as tokens is most of the "feel".
2. **Choreography by offset, not by sequence.** Every element of a hero is placed on one timeline at the same label
   with small delays (0.25, 0.45, 0.5, 0.525 s) — nothing waits for anything to finish, so the page assembles in a
   single 1-second gesture.
3. **Words, not lines.** Titles split into words that spring from a squashed, rotated state with an ~88 ms stagger;
   decorative text splits into characters at ~16 ms.
4. **Two-phase hover.** Squash fast (150 ms), recover slowly with overshoot (350 ms after a 150 ms delay); optionally
   jiggle the label's letters. Hover-only on fine pointers, and the same on `:focus-visible`.
5. **Scroll is either "once" or "scrub", never pinned.** Entrances fire once at `top 80–95%`; continuous effects
   (parallax, sequences) scrub with a small lag (0.2–0.5).
6. **Lerped scroll** (lerp 0.2) so wheel input glides; stopped during transitions and overlays.
7. **Everything gated** behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.

To reproduce the *type* of system in a React app without the site's content: easing tokens in CSS; a single
IntersectionObserver that adds an "in view" class once (or CSS scroll-driven animations for scrubbed parallax); a word
splitter component that sets `--i` per word for a CSS stagger; the two-phase hover as plain CSS; a small lerped
wheel smoother that steps aside for nested scrollers, modals, ctrl/pinch zoom, touch and reduced motion; and a short
view-change transition keyed on the current view. GSAP/Lenis are optional — the timing values matter more than the
library. GovOS's implementation of this blueprint is described in CLAUDE.md under "Motion".
